onboarding_welcome_subtitle: Obuyambi mu mpuliziganya n’obukuumi eri abantu Abatawulira n’abafuna obuzibu mu kuwulira
onboarding_welcome_desc: SilentHelp egatta obubaka obw’amangu, abantu be weesiga, empeereza eziriraanye, amagezi ku bukuumi ku mutimbagano n’ebikozesebwa mu mpuliziganya.
onboarding_sos_step1: Ggulawo Eby’amangu okuteeka SOS oba obubaka nti Ndi bulungi / Nneetaaga obuyambi
onboarding_sos_step2: Londa abantu bo ab’omu bantu bo ab’eesiga abafuna SMS y’embeera yo
onboarding_sos_step3: Essaawa n’ekifo byo biyinza okuteekebwamu singa olukusa n’omukutu byebisobozesa
onboarding_profile_step1: Ggulawo Wasifu okwongera oba okutereeza ebikwata ku ggwe
onboarding_profile_step2: Yongera abantu be weesiga olonde abafuna obubaka bwo obw’embeera
onboarding_profile_step3: Kola kaadi yo y'dijiitala erina ebyalolereza mu nkola z'okuweereza
onboarding_language_subtitle: Oyinza okukyusa kino buli kiseera mu Enteekateeka
onboarding_phrases_subtitle: Kozesa Talk mode, obubaka obwangu n’okusoma olulimi lw’obubonero
onboarding_phrases_desc: Londa ekikukolera. Obubaka obwangu buyamba mu mbeera eza bulijjo; Talk mode eyamba okwogera n’okuwandiika.
onboarding_circle_subtitle: Tegeka abantu abakuyamba era onoonye empeereza eziriraanye
onboarding_circle_step1: Yongera abantu be weesiga ng’ab’omu maka, omusomesa, omuluŋŋamya oba omukozi w’eddwaliro mu Wasifu
onboarding_circle_step2: Kebera abantu bo ab’eesiga olonde abafuna obubaka bwo obw’embeera
onboarding_circle_step3: Kozesa Ebifo okunoonya amalwaliro, poliisi oba ebifo ebikuumiddwa ebiriraanye
onboarding_digital_subtitle: Funa amagezi ag’omugaso otegeke ky’oyinza okukola
onboarding_digital_step1: Obukuumi ku Mutimbagano buwa amagezi ku kyama, okunyigiriza n’obulabe ku yintaneeti nga tewali yintaneeti
onboarding_digital_step2: Alipoota esobola okukeberwa n’okusindikibwa mu SMS eri omuntu gw’olonda; si alipoota ya butongole
onboarding_digital_step3: Tereka enteekateeka yo ku ssimu eno; tesibiddwa era tesindika kulabula yokka
complete_required: Omuntu w'obuyamba kyetaagisa okukozesa feature ya SOS
incomplete_warning: ⚠️ Purofayiri yo tekyakakasibwa. Emergency SOS kyetaaga embuzi z'omuntu w'obuyamba.
profile_instructions: Jaza okuwedde embuzi z'omuntu w'obuyamba okuweza feature ya Emergency SOS.
pick_from_contacts: Londa okuva mu namba za simu
contacts_permission_denied: Olukusa lwa namba za simu lwetaagisa okuwandika omuntu w'obuyamba.
contacts_selected: Omuntu w'obuyamba yateekebwa okuva mu namba za simu.
sos_prepared: ✓ Obubaka bwa SOS butegeezeddwa era bufungulidde mu programu ya SMS
digital_safety_intro: Emitendera egy’okwekuuma ku mutimbagano. Eby’okulabirako bino biterekeddwa mu pulogulaamu era bikola nga tewali yintaneeti.
digital_protect_body: Kozesa ekkomo ku ssikirini n’ekigambo eky’ekyama ekizibu era eky’enjawulo. Kozesa okukakasa okw’emirundi ebiri bwe kubeerawo, era towa muntu namba za kukakasa.
digital_privacy_body: Kendeeza ku bantu abalaba ebikwata ku ggwe, bye oteeka ku mutimbagano, ekifo kyo n’ennamba zo. Ddamu okukebera ensengeka zino oluvannyuma lw’okutereeza pulogulaamu.
digital_harassment_body: Teweetaaga kuddamu. Bwe kiba nga tekikuteeka mu kabi, ziyiza era oloppe akawunti eyo, era otegeeze omuntu gw’eesiga. Weewale okwolekagana n’omuntu ayinza okukuteeka mu kabi.
digital_image_body: Toddamu kusindika bifaananyi bya kyama oba eby’okunyigiriza. Tereka amannya ga akawunti, ennyunzi, ennaku n’obubaka singa kiba kya bukuumi. Saba omuntu omukulu gw’eesiga oba ekitongole eky’ obuyambi.
digital_pause_body: Kebera ensibuko, olunaku n’embeera y’ekigambo. Weegendereze amawulire aganguwa, ebifaananyi ebikyusiddwa n’okusaba ebikwata ku bulamu bwo.
digital_emergency_note: Bw’oba mu kabi aka kaakano, kozesa Eby’amangu oba tuukirira abakola ku mbeera ez’amangu mu kitundu kyo. Pulogulaamu eno tetumira alipoota eri abakulembeze.
report_contacts_error: Tekisobose kutikka bantu bo be weesiga.
report_privacy_notice: Alipoota eno esigala ku ssikirini eno okutuusa lw’olonda omuntu n’okukkiriza. Etumibwa eri omuntu oyo mu SMS, si eri abakulembeze oba SilentHelp.
report_category_impersonation: Omuntu okwefuula omulala oba akawunti ey’obulimba
report_details_hint: Wandiika ebyo byokka by’owulira nga osobola okwogera mu bukuumi.
report_details_toggle_hint: Ebisingawo si byetaagisa era biyinza okulabika mu SMS. Leka kino nga kizikiddwa okuggyako ng’oyagala okubigabana.
report_evidence_note: Toddamu kusindika bifaananyi bya kyama. Pulogulaamu eno tetereka bujulizi era tesindika kifo kyo mu alipoota eno.
report_no_contacts_body: Yongera omuntu gw’eesiga mu Wasifu. Alipoota etumibwa eri oyo gw’olonda yekka.
report_choose_category_contact: Londa ekika kya alipoota n’omuntu gw’eesiga.
report_sms_heading: Alipoota y’obukuumi ku mutimbagano eya SilentHelp
report_sms_request: Nkwegayiridde otuukirire nange mu bukuumi twogere ku buyambi.
report_sms_visibility_warning: Omuntu yenna asobola okulaba SMS singa afuna essimu yo oba obubaka bwo.
report_sms_delivered: Amawulire agalaga nti SMS etuuse ku nnamba erondeddwa gafuniddwa. Kino tekikakasa nti obubaka busomeddwa.
report_sms_opened: SMS egguddwawo. Kebera ogisindike mu pulogulaamu yo ey’obubaka.
report_sms_permission_error: Olukusa lwa SMS luziyiziddwa. Kebera ensengeka z’ekyuma oddemu ogezeeko, oba kozesa pulogulaamu y’obubaka.
safety_plan_intro: Lowooza ku mitendera mitono nga tonnaba kugyetaaga. Okutereka enteekateeka tekutukirira muntu yenna era tekusangiza kifo kyo.
safety_plan_privacy_warning: Enteekateeka eno eterekebwa ku ssimu eno nga tekozesa kusiba bubaka. Omuntu omulala bw’asobola okuggulawo essimu eno, ayinza okugiraba. Weewale okuwandiika ebyama ku ssimu ekozesa abantu abalala.
safety_plan_safe_place_hint: Okugeza, eka ya muliraanwa gw’eesiga oba eddwaliro
safety_plan_code_word_hint: Mukkaanyiziganye ku kigambo ekitegeeza nti weetaaga obuyambi
safety_plan_steps_hint: Okugeza: genda mu kifo ekisingako obukuumi, tuukirira omuntu gw’eesiga, oba kozesa Eby’amangu.
safety_plan_saved: Enteekateeka y’obukuumi eterekeddwa ku ssimu eno.
safety_plan_no_auto_send: Enteekateeka eno ya kusoma ggwe. Tesindika kulabula yokka era si kifo kya bakola ku mbeera ez’amangu.
safety_plan_clear_confirm: Kino kijja kuggyawo enteekateeka y’obukuumi eterekeddwa ku ssimu eno.
trusted_circle_subtitle: Laba abantu be weesiga n’enteekateeka yo ey’obuyambi
places_subtitle: Noonya amalwaliro, amalwaliro amatono ne poliisi ebiriraanye
